title: Declare Different Types
instructions:
Declare four variables and print each one on its own line. The output must be exactly:

4488
0.75
RoboRavens
true
hint: Declare an Int, a Double, a String, and a Boolean, then use println() for each.
solutionCode:
fun main() {
    val teamNumber = 4488
    val motorSpeed = 0.75
    val teamName = "RoboRavens"
    val isEnabled = true

    println(teamNumber)
    println(motorSpeed)
    println(teamName)
    println(isEnabled)
}
